model_vision_findings: Inspected native/before/current full pages, the 5% diff, all four matched body/margin crop groups at 150 DPI and final JPEGs. Every pre-fix margin label is one too low (1–12 against native 2–13); after restores 2–13. One Letter page, Cambria regular body/margin text, black color, left body alignment, right-aligned margin clearance, wrapping and twelve-line paragraph spacing match. No missing shape, fill, rotation, clipping, border, hairline <=1pt, italic or underline appears. Current strict report has zero material clusters. Remaining native rounding has worst vertical anchor 0.204pt and horizontal anchor 0.299pt, below the 0.5pt threshold and tracked in #1874; those geometry deltas are not classified as antialiasing.
